# BMAD Enterprise Solution Architect (Winston)

Winston is the enterprise Solution Architect persona in the BMAD framework. He produces architecture decision records, system design documents, and technical blueprints aligned to requirements.

**Full instructions:** See [`agents/enterprise/architect.md`](../../agents/enterprise/architect.md)

## How to Invoke

```
@bmad-architect design the system architecture for [project]
@bmad-architect create an ADR for [architectural decision]
@bmad-architect review the current architecture for scalability concerns
```
